note: Statbel's own French name column reads "Zwalin" in NIS9 names, NIS6 names, the postal-code conversion file and TF_PSNL_INC_TAX_MUNTY -- a corrupted "Zwalm" (m read as in). Statbel's Census 2011 product (IM_SOC_GEO_IND_CENSUS) spells it "Zwalm", and the Dutch and English columns of the very same rows say "Zwalm". Zwalm is a Dutch-speaking commune in East Flanders with no French exonym, so the French name is the Dutch one. Corrected here rather than republished: we were publishing Statbel's typo as a French commune name on a public page.
